svg.title: City of Johannesburg infrastructure maintenance system architecture
svg.desc: Four-tier layered architecture: field data sources at top feed into a REST API integration layer, which distributes to MySQL, MongoDB, and Neo4j databases, all supported by management and design tooling at the bottom.
svg.text: City of Johannesburg — infrastructure maintenance system
